Name: Krobus Sells Larger Stacks
Author: Annosz
Description:
[size=5]Krobus Sells Larger Stacks[/size]

Krobus sells a few very useful items and ones that are hard to come buy. But he has a rotating weekly schedule and if you want to buy a great number of mixed seeds or iridium sprinklers you don't want to wait weeks to get the desired amount. In these cases this mod can help: it makes the quantity of items that Krobus sells fully configurable in the config.json file (at default, it adds a little to every stack).

Currently the following items can be accessed in Krobus's shop: Dark Essence, Solar Essence,  Slime,  Omni GeodeQuantity,  MixedSeeds,  Iridium Sprinkler,  Bat Wing, Magnet, multiple Fishes and various foods. This mod can not add new items (you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2278]Shop Expander[/url] for that) and does not change the weekly distribution of these goods.



[size=4]Requirements[/size]

This mod requires SMAPI.



﻿[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][list=1][code][/code][/list]
